g.text: Session and error transitions
Error latch (red LED) is independent of workflow state.
Several errors: LEDs show the highest priority, then the first latched.
Short press acknowledges non-restart faults; no implicit retry.
Wi-Fi recovery does not require acknowledgement.
Acknowledgement keeps the current workflow and causes no Start.

Measuring
Analysing

ReportingError
Start = Busy, visible activity.
No cancellation or queued Start.
Start cancels the delivery on both send paths;
the result is lost. Start is never queued.
Exclusive network lease; audio stopped.
A session context change is latched silently and listening continues;
after the manual Stop the device halts, discards the result and requires a restart.
The device never applies the rejected identity and invalidates a halted acquisition.
Wi-Fi-only faults preserve functioning audio.
Audio faults halt listening immediately.
The error indication is latched separately from workflow;
acknowledgement does not change an active workflow.
Non-Wi-Fi faults halt;
during listening only audio faults halt at once,
other halting faults wait for the manual Stop.
The device mutes, invalidates incomplete work and blocks Start.
Restart-required faults cannot be cleared by short press.
software-observable startup checks pass

or after exhausted link recovery / Idle network lease, scan then open hotspot
verified join and save (or save warning) / show result, close access point and portal server, retain station
cancel or inactivity / notice, teardown, retain station if connected
Start, L2_AUDIO reports started / safe setup teardown first; retain established station
Heart session begins / freeze context
audio fault / mute, block every input
manual Stop with a deferred halting fault / show error
audio fault / mute, invalidate, block every input
manual Stop with a deferred halting fault / discard result, show error
Stop in Lung (optional) / mute, no BPM or send
Stop below minimum session length / cancel, no send
Stop at or above minimum session length / mute, finalize
